hypothesis: Batch 1024 reduces eight serialized inference dispatches to one for identical pending games. Exact native work must survive different batch-shaped JAX executables.
required_validation: Frozen compare.py requires identical feature requests, targets, game records, complete actor state except diagnostic root values (absolute tolerance 1e-5), and useful work counters on all four hosts. Any mismatch is a failure, not evidence of speedup.
timing_interpretation: Qualification includes trace hashing and can overlap the FPU KataGo evaluation on disjoint physical CPUs64-95. Timing is diagnostic only. Formal timing follows only after parity, with hashing disabled, registered repetitions, and no other evaluation workload.
